name: The Key to Twilight
author: Custom local mod
description:
Bring the power of Kingdom Hearts into The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess with this crossover mod for Dusklight!

Customize your adventure with selectable Keyblades and playable Kingdom Hearts characters. Choose the Kingdom Key, play as Xion from Kingdom Hearts III, and use character replacements with the Ordon Clothes, Hero's Clothes, Zora Armor, and Magic Armor. Choose "None" in the mod settings to restore Link's original appearance or the default Ordon Sword.

Planned features include additional characters and Keyblades, Kingdom Hearts-inspired combat, Fire, Blizzard, Thunder, Cure, and more visual effects and customization options.

The worlds of light and twilight collide!

Fan-made crossover mod. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Nintendo, Square Enix, or Disney.
